covered.rule: 1. First sentence: automated assistant of Bank 15, call is recorded; ask with title and last name
2. Never say collections, debt, payment, credit card or loan before verification
3. Clear yes only; ask once more; unreached/unclear
4. Robot reply / scam reply and continue
5. Third party: say nothing about purpose, ask when reachable
6 + Ops 7 Oct point 4. Callback today or next business day, 10:00-17:30 inclusive, after now; unreached/callback
7. Time outside window: ask once more; unreached/no_callback
8. Wrong number: unreached/wrong_number
9. Deceased: 'I am sorry for your loss.' unreached/deceased
10. Refuses to talk: no_arrangement/declined_payment
11 + Ops point 1. Order date_of_birth, phone_last4; formats unchanged (mdy, 6 digits)
12 + Ops point 1. 2 wrong answers in total; wrong_answers_left
13. 'Please use the mobile app or visit a branch.' unverified/failed
14. Explain once; second refusal unverified/declined
15/29 + Ops point 4. Human request: transfer immediately to desk, handed_over/person
16. Business days Mon-Fri, holidays list
17. 'Next <weekday>' = following week
18. Collections team intro; up to 3 products; state all; ask once pay all today
19. Floors per product type and spoken names
20. Full first, never ask how much, floor once with 'the rest stays overdue'
21. Promise date rules
22. band1 table row: today+9 calendar days, previous business day, 2 attempts
22 + Ops point 2. band2: third business day, 1 attempt
23. Attempt 1 full on last business day this/next week (floor if full refused); attempt 2 floor on deadline
24. Attempts used up: noted declined_payment
25. Already paid sentence, note settled, continue
26. Dispute: note disputed, continue
27. Hardship: sympathy, offer care, decline no_arrangement/distress, may still record promise
28. Restructuring transfer restructure; promises stay
30. Read-back, 'Do you confirm?', one promise per product
31. 'You will receive a text message confirming this promise.'
32 + Compliance 9 Oct (overrides Ops point 3). No retry; no_arrangement/system_error
33. 'You can change it in the mobile app.'
34. Common date clamped; one read-back; transfer keeps promise
35. One note per unpromised product; reasons list; no notes on transfer
36. Goodbye before close_call; outcome/reason table
37. Outcome precedence
